sources.relevant_excerpt: Tourist Visa (category TR). Visa fee: 1,000 Baht per entry (fees may change without notice). Visa validity: 3 or 6 months. Upon arrival, travellers with this type of visa will be permitted to stay in Thailand for a period of not exceeding 60 days. Passport validity: minimum 6 months. Evidence of travel from Thailand (air ticket paid in full). Financial proof: 20,000 Baht per person and 40,000 Baht per family. Nationals of certain countries are required to apply for a visa only at the Thai Embassy or Consulate-General in their home/residence country.

sources.relevant_excerpt: UK ordinary passport holders can travel to Thailand without visa for no longer than 60 days. Foreigners entering Thailand by any means under the Visa Exemption scheme are required at the port of entry to have proof of planned travel (confirmed air, train, bus, or boat tickets) to leave Thailand within 60 days. UK travel documents classified as Refugee or Emergency documents do not qualify and require a visa.

60-Day Visa Exemption: nationals of 93 countries and territories qualify for visa exemption, up to 60 days period of stay and can be extended for another period not exceeding 30 days. Complete list of 93: Albania, Andorra, Australia, Austria, Bahrain, Belgium, Bhutan, Brazil, Brunei, Bulgaria, Cambodia, Canada, China, Colombia, Croatia, Cuba, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Dominica, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, Estonia, Fiji, Finland, France, Georgia, Germany, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, Iceland, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Jamaica, Japan, Jordan, Kazakhstan, Korea (ROK), Kosovo, Kuwait, Laos, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Macao, Malaysia, Maldives, Malta, Mauritius, Mexico, Monaco, Mongolia, Morocco, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Oman, Panama, Papua New Guinea, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Russia, San Marino, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Slovakia, Slovenia, South Africa, Spain, Sri Lanka, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Tonga, Trinidad and Tobago, Turkiye, Ukraine, UAE, UK, USA, Uruguay, Uzbekistan, Vietnam. sources.relevant_excerpt: On 19 May 2026 the Cabinet approved: revoking the 60-day visa exemption scheme for all 93 countries/territories; revising the 30-day visa exemption scheme for tourism purpose and reducing the list of eligible countries/territories (from 57) to 54 countries/territories; introducing the new 15-day visa exemption scheme for tourism purpose for 3 countries/territories; and revising VoA and reducing the list of eligible countries/territories (from 31) to 4 countries/territories. Details and criteria can be found in relevant Ministry of Interior announcements, which will be published in the Royal Gazette and will take effect 15 days after publication. Thereafter, visitors may enter via (1) the new visa schemes; (2) bilateral visa exemption agreements; or (3) an appropriate visa which can be conveniently applied through Thailand's e-Visa system.
